label_provenance.review_scope: whether the exposed parent/child payload contains direct evidence for an AND/OR gate after the original decisive gate sentence is withheld
label_provenance.rule: When decisive gate evidence is absent from the model-visible scope, classify as unknown even if the original source elsewhere contains a gate statement; this is a paired counterfactual evidence-ablation control, not a source-level re-labeling.
label_provenance.review_note: The user confirmed that co-occurrence alone is not an AND gate. These labels test evidence dependence under the declared FTA semantics; they are not human domain-expert Gold or independent second-agent findings.

inference_input_policy: The model receives the same parent and direct-child text as the paired known-gate case, plus parent-scope context. The decisive candidate-set heading and gate sentence are withheld. Pair IDs, source identity, original label, and original decisive quote are withheld.
scope_note: Paired evidence-ablation probe: six previously tested positive AND/OR examples are re-presented with their decisive gate wording and candidate-set heading removed. All exposed-scope labels are unknown. This tests dependence on provided evidence and abstention, not natural-distribution accuracy or source-level truth.

gate_nodes.parent_event: Cabin temperature does not respond to control during auto or manual operation.
gate_nodes.parent_evidence: Trouble: Cabin temperature too high or too low (will not respond to control during auto or manual operation).
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The source's explicit cause relation and disjunction are withheld; the exposed parent context contains 'or' about high/low cabin temperature, which is not evidence for a gate among these two child causes.

gate_nodes.parent_event: Catastrophic fire or explosion of the pump system.
children: Safety system fails to mitigate the failure.
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The direct statement requiring both child events is withheld. The 'or' in the parent event names alternative outcomes, not the relation between these child events.

gate_nodes.parent_event: System failure or accident occurs by the specified critical path.
gate_nodes.parent_evidence: The source identifies the system failure or accident as the top event.
gate_nodes.label_rationale: The text requiring both resistor failures is withheld. The 'or' in the parent names top-event outcomes, not the child gate.

gate_nodes.label_rationale: The definition requiring all inputs to coexist is withheld; parent/child event names alone do not establish a Boolean gate.

limitations: All six rows are paired synthetic evidence-ablation controls derived from six previously tested positive cases, not six naturally sampled source passages.
Two CARE III controls share the same document cluster, so there are six nodes from five source clusters.
The FAA source is cancelled/superseded and is included only as a historical text-classification control, not current maintenance guidance.
The paired original decisive quote is withheld from model input but remains in the separate original fixture and source documents; model pretraining exposure cannot be ruled out.
Labels are AI-assigned from the evidence shown to the model before inference, not human expert Gold or independent second-agent review.

This probe tests abstention when gate wording is absent from the supplied scope; it does not estimate natural-distribution accuracy, calibrate confidence, or validate source extraction, cause completeness, recursive FTA generation, database integration, or production readiness.
